title: Sample record
purpose: Follow one received physical sample from its collection and receipt through containers, test work, preservation decisions, custody and issued report versions.

sections.title: Progress route
paragraphs: Under the title, six stops summarise where the sample stands: Received, Disposition, In a batch, Results entered, Reviewed and Reported. It summarises the statuses shown further down the page; it decides nothing and changes nothing.

items.label: Received
items.description: Always done; shows the receipt time.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Done with the disposition (Proceed or Qualify). On Hold it is the current stop, marked “Hold: decide before work starts”; on Reject, “Rejected at receipt”. The later stops then wait.

items.label: In a batch / Results entered / Reviewed / Reported
items.description: Each shows how many of the sample’s requested tests have reached it: batched or sent to an external laboratory; with a result entered; approved; contained in an issued report version. A stop is done when every test has reached it. The first stop not reached by every test is the current one. With no requested tests the stops read “No tests requested”.

sections.title: Access and header
paragraphs: All laboratory staff can read this record; portal accounts cannot use this staff page. A discrepancy or non-Proceed disposition is highlighted with the receipt discrepancy and current disposition note.

items.label: Lab ID / Client sample / Matrix
items.description: Stable laboratory accession, client identifier, and the recorded matrix with the sample source after a dot when one is recorded.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: The sample’s matrix tag (Water, Wastewater or Soil, with its icon) and the sample source, right after the disposition.

items.label: Sample type / Rush
items.description: The sample type is shown in the header when it is not an ordinary Field sample (Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank). A Rush marker appears when the chain of custody’s turnaround is Rush.

items.label: Client / Project / Delivery target
items.description: Ownership and explicit target inherited from the chain of custody; the target is not an analytical holding deadline. Once the target has passed it carries a red “Overdue N d” pill (just “Overdue” on the day itself); within the seven days before it, an amber “Due in N d” or “Due today” pill. Otherwise the date stands alone.

items.label: Change disposition
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators open a reasoned decision change. While the sample is on Hold it is the page’s primary action, because nothing else can proceed until the disposition is decided.

items.label: Correct sample details
items.description: Receipt roles open correction tabs for identity, collection, observations, requested tests and matrix; later work can lock individual sections.

items.label: Labels
items.description: Any authorized staff member opens identity-label options. Each container is the default; Each sample prints sample identity. Copies of each is 1–10, initially 1. Download PDF opens one 4 × 2 inch label per page, maximum 200 total, for printing at actual size. No sample/custody state changes; reprint when displayed identity facts are corrected.

items.label: Next holding deadline
items.description: The requested test whose collection-based holding deadline comes first among the tests still waiting for analysis, with the deadline and the time left. When that test’s clock is at risk the time left is an amber pill; once expired, a red “Expired … ago” pill. It is absent when no waiting test has a holding rule. The Requested tests table shows every test’s clock.

items.label: Chain of custody
items.description: Reference links to the order containing this sample.

items.label: Sample type
items.description: Field sample, Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank, as written on the chain of custody.

items.label: Matrix and source
items.description: The recorded matrix and, after a dot, the sample source; source not recorded appears when none was entered.

items.label: Collection type / Composite started / Collected or Composite ended
items.description: Grab or composite, with composite start only when recorded, and collection/composite-end timestamp. Displayed times use the configured laboratory zone.

items.label: Collection location / Collector
items.description: Specific collection place and person. A missing place reads Not recorded.

items.label: Sample remarks
items.description: Shown only when remarks were recorded: appearance, odor, hazards or field readings from the chain of custody.

items.label: Received / Received by
items.description: Actual receipt time and staff member who recorded receipt.

items.label: Cooler temperature / Instrument
items.description: Original exact reading text in °C when available; otherwise the numeric value is shown with reading text not recorded. The optional thermometer is shown below as Instrument. This observation is not itself a global acceptance threshold.

items.label: Coolant on arrival
items.description: Wet ice, Ice packs, Dry ice or None, or Not recorded for samples received before coolant was captured. Independent of the temperature reading.

items.label: Custody seal / Preservation check
items.description: Observed receipt conditions as recorded, including any text entered under Other…; distinct from later test-specific screening.

items.label: Current location
items.description: Latest recorded sample custody location.

items.label: Physical storage
items.description: Retention and disposal opens the separate physical storage record.

items.label: Analyte and method
items.description: One row per requested definition, ordered by analyte then record ID; displays analyte and exact method version.

items.label: Default reporting limit
items.description: Current catalog default with unit. A blank/default-free definition is not a zero. Each actual result retains its applied limit.

items.label: Work status and holding time
items.description: Not in a batch, Awaiting entry, Entered, Awaiting review, Returned, Approved, or Sent to an external laboratory. The batch number opens batch detail; Result appears once a revision exists. An active external route links its subcontract.

items.label: Send out
items.description: Receipt roles can start an external handoff on a test shown as Not in a batch. Submission rechecks sample disposition, storage, preparation and internal work; a visible link does not guarantee dispatch eligibility.

items.label: Holding time
items.description: Before a result revision exists, shows the shortest active collection-start rule’s deadline for method/matrix. Not-batched, awaiting-entry and returned work can show time left, At risk within the configured warning window, or Expired after the deadline. No rule means no active collection-start rule. With a result revision, shows its frozen Met, Exceeded, Not evaluable or No rule evaluation; it is not recalculated from today’s clock.

items.label: Preservation
items.description: Screens recorded cooler temperature against this test’s configured rule. This is not a statement about container or chemical preservation. Shows current assessment disposition or Needs an assessment. An Out of date assessment no longer matches receipt, rule or test evidence. Earlier Hold/Reject can still block approval/release until reassessed even when evidence changed. Findings are Within configured temperature range, Outside configured temperature range, No temperature requirement, Rule not configured or Manual review required. Configured bounds are inclusive and the exact unrounded reading is compared without unit conversion; no temperature requirement does not assess other preservation requirements.

items.label: Assess / Assessment
items.description: Opens evidence and assessment history. Custodians, project managers, reviewers and administrators may record decisions there; the destination enforces its permissions.

items.label: Reported
items.description: Links stored issued PDFs for this test, newest first. Latest issued marks the newest; prior version is an older version of the same report; earlier, separate report is another lineage. Not reported means no issued link. A newer unissued correction does not erase old report links.

items.label: Add or withdraw tests
items.description: Receipt roles open test changes. No tests requested is an explicit empty state.

items.label: Label
items.description: Generated container identity under this sample.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Container type recorded at receipt (a listed value or text entered under Other…).

items.label: Preservative
items.description: Container-specific recorded preservative or a dash. It is an observation recorded at receipt, not a method assessment.

items.label: Condition at receipt
items.description: Original observed condition. No containers recorded is a separate empty state.

items.label: Current as of
items.description: These are today’s informational laboratory records; they do not show historic conditions or grant/block authority.

items.label: Open nonconformances
items.description: Linked open issues, newest first, showing identifier/title, status, severity and optional owner; the identifier opens detail. Closed linked issues are counted separately.

items.label: Equipment: Asset, Status, Calibration due, Maintenance due
items.description: Equipment explicitly assigned to this sample’s analytical batches, ordered by asset ID. Asset opens its record. Latest due dates show Not scheduled, Due today, Due in days, Overdue days or Scheduled; calibration can also show Last not acceptable. Missing equipment is not inferred.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological receipt/transfers/disposal, disposition changes, corrections and preservation assessments, including actor, event time, reason and old/new values where relevant. Custody entries also name relinquishing/receiving custodians, movement and recorded time. Superseded preservation assessments remain visible.

items.label: To location
items.description: Transfer-only required destination, up to 160 characters; becomes the sample’s current location. It is free text with suggestions from storage locations already recorded on samples.

items.label: Relinquished by / Received by
items.description: Required names of both actual custodians, each up to 160 characters, separate from the signed-in recording actor.

items.label: Occurred at
items.description: Required completed transfer time, initially now, in laboratory local time. Must follow or equal the latest custody event and cannot be future.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation of the transfer.

items.label: Record transfer
items.description: Receipt roles append a custody event and audit event and update location together. Earlier events are retained. Physically disposed samples cannot transfer. Concurrent changes are refused; reload the sample and review custody history before trying again.
